name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you face an early trial in the Tome of Divinity. Protecting the kingdom and rescuing comrades in need show your devotion to the Light.
For dwarves, uncovering Dark Iron spies near Ironforge is vital to the kingdom's defense. It proves to skeptical councilors that an old enemy has entered Dun Morogh.
For the Alliance, exposing Dark Iron sabotage near Ironforge protects the dwarf capital and strengthens northern defenses against covert threats.

faq.answer: Narm Faulk gives you the charge to retrieve enemy scripts and report to his companion Muiredon Battleforge in Ironforge. He is an injured dwarf, wounded fighting Dark Iron spies near Helm's Bed Lake.
faq.q: Who gives The Tome of Divinity quest?

faq.answer: Muiredon Battleforge is a dwarf in Ironforge. He scouted the Dark Iron spies near Helm's Bed Lake with Narm Faulk, then returned to the city to recover from his wounds.
The Dark Iron Script contains written orders passed between Dark Iron spies and their captain near Helm's Bed Lake. It offers evidence of hostile infiltration for Ironforge's skeptical council.
faq.q: What is the Dark Iron Script?

faq.answer: Some members of Ironforge's council doubt Dark Iron dwarves have entered Dun Morogh. The recovered scripts prove their movements and reveal their secret plans.
faq.q: Why does the council in Ironforge need proof of the Dark Irons?

faq.answer: The Dark Iron spies operate near Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh, east of Kharanos. They work near a small house, passing covert battle orders.
faq.q: Where are the Dark Iron spies located?

aliases: what does the tome of divinity teach
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity trials test an aspiring paladin's service, compassion, and courage. By helping fallen comrades such as Narm and defending Dun Morogh, you prove your devotion to the Light.
faq.q: What role does this quest play for paladins?

sections.body: Young dwarven paladins answer the call to defend Dun Morogh when an expedition near Helm's Bed Lake goes wrong. Narm Faulk and Muiredon Battleforge set out to ambush Dark Iron scouts. Narm fell wounded, while Muiredon returned to Ironforge to recover.
sections.title: A Trial of Service

sections.body: Rumors of Dark Iron infiltrators have reached Ironforge, yet some council members refuse to believe they have entered Dun Morogh. Near Helm's Bed, the paladin can track down the spies and recover a Dark Iron Script from their captain. The orders offer proof of enemy movements and plots near the capital's gates.
sections.title: Proof for the Council

sections.body: Bringing the intercepted orders to Muiredon Battleforge in Ironforge brings relief. Narm has been rescued, and the documents go to Muiredon's wife to present before the council. The paladin's bravery and devotion to the Light help guard the dwarven realm from hidden treachery.
sections.title: Securing the Hearth

summary: In Dun Morogh, injured scouts need help exposing Dark Iron spies near Helm's Bed Lake. Their orders may persuade Ironforge's skeptical council to heed the danger.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
